description: Small synthetic retrieval set for the local baseline.

documents.text: Employees receive twenty paid vacation days each calendar year. Vacation requests go to the manager.
Customers may request a refund within thirty days of purchase. Digital goods are refundable only if unused.
Production secrets must be stored in the managed secret store. Never commit credentials to source control.
